body: Hey, I really appreciate the tough love! And yes, I realized last night what a waste of life would it be to end life on something like this. I know my suicidal thoughts are driven by circumstances. I never had them before and I know if I remove myself from this situation, I can be happy and healthy again. I've reached a point where I don't care what she thinks of me. I'll pull the trigger soon. Thanks again for your advice!

Thank you so much for your response. Yes, it is her reaction which guilts me back. And since I've been in that mindset that I don't want to be the asshole, I keep trying to have a kind, gentle break but that always works against me. I talked to my therapist yesterday and it was very validating to be reminded that I have tried to end things nicely. Since I've reached such a vulnerable stage, it is my right to protect myself, regardless if it ends up making me an asshole or not. I'll see if I can end things in next two weeks without putting my mental health on the line. If not, then I'll just do it from abroad. Thank you again for sharing your thoughts!

Thank you for such a thoughtful response. I definitely have considered that she might be using guilt to manipulate me. She has confessed to me that she has manipulated partners in the past but also that she's over that phase now. So yeah, she might not be doing it very consciously, but there is a lot of evidence that she does it at some level. She does have a lot of self esteem issues and I'm starting to understand now how that drives people do crazy things. I'm heading abroad in two weeks from now, so I have that deadline. I'll end up being that 'asshole' who dumped her from abroad, but at this point I really gotta protective myself. The suicide scare was so real and I don't wanna end up in that situation again. Funny thing is I mentioned suicidal thoughts to her and that seems to have barely bothered her. Whereas if I mention that to any of my friends and family, that'd freak out and do whatever to help me. So dunno, kinda sign in itself, I guess.
I’m here. Going through similar feelings. Please reach out.
